$comment: Generated from the program by opensloper-cli doc layout.schema.json; do not edit it by hand.
title: OpenSloper layout file (.slayout)
description: Made by opensloper-publish: where the pieces of one or more patterns go on the pages, roll or material, and how they print. Positions are plain numbers in mm, from the top left, y down.

format.description: What the file is; a file with another value does not load

version.description: The version of the format; a program refuses a file newer than it knows

units.description: Always mm: values in this file are millimetres

name.description: The layout's name, for the title block

nextId.description: The next source ID to hand out

sources.description: The patterns laid out, each with the measurements to draw it with

id.description: The source's ID, which placements refer to

pattern.description: The pattern file, relative to the layout's folder

measurementFile.description: The measurement file, relative to the layout's folder; the pattern's own when left out

size.description: The size, for a size table; its first size when left out

output.description: What the layout prints on and how

kind.description: tiled: pages taped together; large: a roll; projector: shown on the material; material: a sheet of material for a cutting machine

paper.description: The paper size, A4, A3 or Letter, or a name of your own with its width and height

paperWidth.description: The paper's width, for a size of your own

paperHeight.description: The paper's height, for a size of your own

margin.description: The edge of the paper left blank

marks.description: The marks for lining up tiles

fill.description: How pieces are filled; none when left out

profile.description: The cutting machine profile, from the settings

outputProfile.description: The output profile, from the settings, which chooses what prints

materialLength.description: The material's length, for material; 0 or left out for as long as needed

allowTurns.description: Whether a piece may lie across the grain, for material

material.description: Only pieces cut from this material, by name

excludedPages.description: Pages left out of the print, by their captions

placements.description: Where each copy of each piece lies

source.description: The source the piece is from

piece.description: The piece's ID in that source's pattern

copy.description: Which copy, from 1, for a piece cut more than once

x.description: The left of the piece's cutting line, after turning and flipping

y.description: The top of the piece's cutting line, after turning and flipping

rotation.description: The turn in degrees, a multiple of 90, anticlockwise

flipped.description: Whether the piece is flipped over, before it is turned

sheetNotes.description: Text placed on the sheet, not on a piece

text.description: The text; it may hold fields such as {date}

box.description: Whether it has a white box behind it

font.description: The font family it prints in; left out for the default sans-serif

titleBlock.description: The title block; no title block when left out

corner.description: The corner of the page it sits in

everyPage.description: Whether it is on every page, not only the first
